title: Mine amethyst in geodes: a harvest_amethyst skill that digs its own way to them, with an activity adapter, locked until researched (from B25x2's wanted list, #91)
brief: Add a foundry skill `harvest_amethyst` to the real-Minecraft world (Mineflayer), so a village member digs its own way down to amethyst clusters sealed underground and mines them for amethyst shard, and so the village's `activity` chore kind can run it from a library spec once members have researched it. Members have asked for it: this ticket was made by scripts/foundry_queue.py from village B25x2's wanted list (G6, #91): opens 3 items (0 used: amethyst_block, tinted_glass, spyglass); 9 members wish for spyglass (their life goals); 142 raw_copper held idle that its items would use; 46 chunks within 144 of the hut hold amethyst_cluster or budding_amethyst. THE GAME: a geode is a sealed ball underground (y -58 to 30): an outer shell of smooth basalt, then calcite, then a lining of amethyst blocks with budding amethyst among them, hollow inside; amethyst clusters grow on budding amethyst and a pickaxe breaks one for 4 shards (2 without); budding amethyst gives nothing when broken and is what regrows the clusters, so it is never broken; the walk-and-dig pathfinder does not reach a cluster inside the shell (live, 10-22: collect stopped at the shell). Foundry skills live one file each in server/src/mineflayer/foundry/ and export `FOUNDRY: FoundrySkill` (read foundry/types.ts: name, skill (an McSkill: check + run), tool (a ToolDef: name, a one-sentence description a model can act on, input_schema), activity (place, holds)); list it in foundry/list.ts (one import, and one entry inside the array before `].map(locked)`: keep `.map(locked)`, which locks a researched activity); edit no other table. THE SKILL `harvest_amethyst`, arguments: x, y, z (one amethyst cluster to go for, given by the adapter), count (amethyst shard wanted, default 4, 1..16), radius (optional, default 32, at most 64: how far to look when x, y, z are not given). It needs a pickaxe in the inventory (any: wooden, stone, iron, diamond or netherite; fail with: 'no pickaxe: withdraw one from storage'). Without x, y, z: the nearest amethyst cluster within radius, found with the project's nearestBlocks helper (mcUtil.ts; never bot.findBlocks: lessons 16 and 49). THE WAY DOWN: walk on the surface (mcUtil walk/reach, which keep off village work and protected ground) to a standable cell 3-6 blocks horizontally from the target's column, not within 8 blocks (x, z) of any village's ground (onVillageGround at the surface), then dig a staircase toward the target: each step digs the two cells ahead at head and feet height and the one below them, and steps down one, by real digs with the pickaxe equipped (bot.dig; Paper times digs by the wall clock: never shorten digTime, lesson 40), never by command; turn toward the target as you go; once beside it, dig straight through what lies between you and the target (the shell: smooth basalt, calcite, amethyst blocks: these may be broken) but NEVER break budding amethyst (step around it: dig a cell beside it instead) and never dig a cell with water, lava or a falling block (sand, gravel) next to it or above it: stop there and fail with what was found ('lava beside the way down at x,y,z: the tunnel stops there'). Read every cell before digging it (bot.blockAt; a cell not loaded or unknown is not dug). Inside, mine every amethyst cluster within 4 blocks that the bot can reach (bot.dig on each, the pickaxe equipped; skip budding amethyst) and pick up the drops (walk to item entities within 6 blocks), until count amethyst shard are gathered or none is left within reach. Then climb back up your own staircase to the surface (walk; the stairs you dug are free cells). At most 48 cells dug in a call and 5 minutes of wall time (divide by the game's tick-rate scale as other skills do with timeScale() from mcRules.ts): past either, stop, climb out and report. Place no block; dig nothing but the staircase, the way through the shell and the amethyst clusters. Count amethyst shard on the server before and after (the a.world.rcon.count helper, as foundry/fish.ts and mcAnimals.ts use). Read server/src/mineflayer/mcMine.ts's digCell, unsafe and digIronStairs for how the village's mine digs safely (do not import them: they are private and tied to the village's mine; write your own small versions in this file). Result message: 'got N amethyst shard from K amethyst clusters at x,y,z (M left within 4 blocks; dug D cells; back at x,y,z)' and why it stopped. Failure messages say what is short and what to do next (lesson 127): no pickaxe; none of the amethyst clusters within radius ('explore to find a geode'); the way down blocked (water, lava, sand above: 'try another one'); the pickaxe broke ('withdraw another'). The skill must accept anything Mineflayer can pass it (a block unloaded or gone, an item entity gone, the bot falling into the hollow: lesson 104); falling does no damage in this world. THE ACTIVITY ADAPTER (activity.place, called inside the menu for every idle member: cheap and never throwing; ctx.hut is the storage hut's centre, none: {why: 'no storage hut'}): keep per village a list of the amethyst clusters found within 144 blocks of the hut, refreshed at most every 10 minutes by one nearestBlocks search from ctx.agent's bot (count up to 24), leaving out any within 8 blocks (x, z) of a village's ground; return {x, y, z} of the nearest one still a amethyst_cluster when read now (bot.blockAt; a cheap read of a loaded chunk), else {why: 'no amethyst cluster known within 144 blocks of the storage hut away from the village (explore to find a geode)'}; cache that answer 1 minute. activity.holds: one key per target's geode, `amethyst:` and the target's x, y, z rounded down to a multiple of 16, so two members never dig toward the same geode. THE LIBRARY SPEC server/library/amethyst.json (read server/src/library.ts: LibrarySpec, validateLibrarySpec and its `research` block): exactly this JSON: {"id": "lib:amethyst", "name": "Mine amethyst in geodes", "skill": "harvest_amethyst", "count": {"arg": "count", "max": 8}, "needs": {"stone_pickaxe": 1}, "gives": [{"item": "amethyst_shard"}], "keep": 16, "effect": "amethyst shard for the workshop's spyglass, amethyst blocks: what members wish for", "research": {"name": "mining amethyst shard in geodes", "requires": {"stone_pickaxe": 1}, "attempt": {"torch": 2}, "minutes": 3, "chance": 0.3, "complexity": 5, "capability": "amethyst", "goods": [{"item": "spyglass", "target": 2, "batch": 1, "unit": 1, "words": "spyglass", "forWhat": "spyglass from the village's amethyst shard (an invention of the village)", "allow": ["amethyst_shard"]}, {"item": "amethyst_block", "target": 2, "batch": 1, "unit": 1, "words": "amethyst blocks", "forWhat": "amethyst blocks from the village's amethyst shard (an invention of the village)", "allow": ["amethyst_shard"]}]}}. Keep its research block as given: it makes the activity a locked innovation entry members unlock by research (tech.ts). THE LIVE CHECK scripts/checks/amethyst.py (Python 3, standard library only, in the style of scripts/checks/fish.py and shear.py: urllib calls to the agent server API, mc/rcon.py through subprocess with the environment passed through so MC_SERVER_DIR picks the server; never default to the main world: if MCAI_API is not set, exit 2). The foundry starts the agent server with MC_INNOVATE=on before it runs the check. The check: find open, dry, level ground near the test site's centre (-1563, -36 on minevale3; read the ground with /api/block, away from any village plot: GET /api/village lists them); build a small geode by RCON 10 blocks below the ground there, 6 blocks horizontally from Gus's spot: `fill` a 7x7x7 cube of smooth_basalt, then a 5x5x5 of calcite inside it, then a 3x3x3 of amethyst_block inside that, then hollow its centre (the single middle cell, air), and set one cell of the lining to budding_amethyst and put 2 amethyst_cluster in the hollow's air against the lining (setblock with facing away from the lining it stands on); spawn Gus on the ground (brain idle, gamemode survival, reset true); give Gus 1 stone_pickaxe by RCON; record the blocks of a box covering the geode and Gus's spot, plus 4 on every side (read with 'execute if block' or /api/block), and of the corridor (the box between Gus's spot and the geode, both included, widened by 1); run `harvest_amethyst` with x, y, z of one amethyst_cluster and `count 2` through /api/agents/Gus/act; wait for action_done or action_failed (up to 6 minutes); then verify: at least 2 amethyst shard more on the server for Gus (count with RCON 'clear Gus minecraft:amethyst_shard 0' before and after); the budding_amethyst is still there; no 'placed' event from Gus; no cell of the big box changed outside the corridor and the geode; Gus stands within 3 blocks of the ground's height (it climbed out); then a second call with x, y, z of a amethyst_cluster cell now mined must fail or report none left, within 3 minutes; then clear Gus's pickaxes by RCON, and a third call must fail with a message containing 'no pickaxe'. Clean up (remove Gus) in a finally (the foundry restores the site before every check). Print one line per verification and end with exactly 'AMETHYST OK' on success or 'AMETHYST FAILED: <why>' and exit 1. Out of scope, no need to read: the HTTP server and panel (server/src/index.ts, api.ts, panel.ts, mineflayer/index.ts, mcApi.ts), mcWorld.ts (it already runs foundry activities from library specs), mcBuild.ts, tech.ts and lock.ts (they lock it already), the pathfinder's sources.
read: server/src/mineflayer/foundry/fish.ts (a foundry skill in the house style: guards, walks, server counts, the adapter)
server/src/mineflayer/foundry/honeycomb.ts: only its activity adapter (a cached block list per village)

server/src/mineflayer/mcUtil.ts: only walk, reach, standableY, nearestBlocks, onVillageGround, sleep, checkAbort, countItem, itemId, at, num, syncInventory
scripts/checks/fish.py (the style of a live check)
